description: This file defines the EmployeeOnLeaveAPI class, which provides an API endpoint to retrieve a list of employees who are on leave today within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for fetching data, applying filters, and handling pagination and sorting, primarily for dashboard widgets related to employee leave status.

classes.name: EmployeeOnLeaveAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for retrieving the list of employees on leave for the current day, with support for filtering, sorting, and pagination within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a list of employees on leave today, applying filters such as date, user accessibility, and leave period configuration; returns a collection result with metadata.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the GET request parameters, including date and sorting options.
